handoff.summary: Cycle 5 completed T-008: phase2-ui is done — all three modes ship. NetworkMode (src/ui/modes/NetworkMode.tsx): per-validator card grid computed with domain observe(log, v, slot, count); each card shows head/justified/finalized/latest vote (source→target); hover or focus renders that validator's local block tree below via BlockTreeView; a card whose head differs from the majority head gets a 分岐中 text flag. GlobalMode (src/ui/modes/GlobalMode.tsx): left ChainMode, right NetworkMode — real components; perspective/selected-validator state lives in App and is shared across modes. Evidence green: typecheck 0, vitest 9 files / 72 tests 0 (tests/ui/appShell.test.tsx now covers network cards at 4 and 7 validators, hover-view swapping via mouseover dispatch, global split-pane interactions), build 0. README status/usage updated for the 3 modes.
next_actions: T-009 (phase3-interventions, cost 5): compile an intervention list into a Delivery rule + protocol overrides — the engine already takes delivery as a parameter (useSimulation(delivery) and domain advanceSlot), do NOT redesign it. UI specifies partition (validator sets), stop/resume, equivocation (double propose/vote), delay-drop of specific messages, all at slot boundaries. Interventions must live in the scenario config so T-011 can persist them. NetworkMode's 分岐中 flag already visualizes divergence — partition scenarios should light it up.

T-010 (phase3-interventions, cost 3): rewind UI — useSimulation already keeps states[slot] (index = slot); add a slot cursor viewing past states; advancing from a past cursor should truncate-or-branch per T-011 scenario design. Batch note: T-009(5)+T-010(3) = 8 ≤ max_context_cost_per_batch 8, same group, so they can share a batch.
UI must keep consuming ONLY src/domain exports (tests/domain/purity.test.ts enforces).

Essence gates: (a) semantics changes of View/Vote/protocol skeleton and (b) large UI look/info-design pivots go back to the human. Discretion already recorded: SVG tree, M1 palette salvage, jsdom verification layer, NetworkMode card+hover design, 分岐中 divergence flag.

Discretionary semantics on record: SLOTS_PER_EPOCH=4; same-slot equivocation resolved lexicographically; anchor slot 0 / first proposal slot 1; attestations of a slot simultaneous (votes visible through s-1).

R-001 (proposed, non-blocking): human may enable real-browser verification via 'npx playwright install chromium' once; until then jsdom DOM tests are the autonomous verification layer. npm install needs --cache "$TMPDIR/npm-cache" under the sandbox.
